# Two reviews ask for changes. Each fix round carries the findings of the review before it. The third review approves.
env REPO=o/r BASE=integration OWNER_LOGIN=owner OWNER_EMAIL=owner@example.com
exec obee run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star
stdout 'item 7 finished'

exec obee status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tdone\tmerge: merged$'

grep -count=1 '^plan ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^implement ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^fix 1 ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^fix 2 ' calls.log
grep -count=3 '^review ' calls.log
! grep '^fix 3 ' calls.log

cmp events.log expected-events.log

-- verdicts --
changes
changes
approve
-- expected-events.log --
claim 7
ready 7
release 7
